themes.evidence: Ethics and integrity are the foundation of our brand and the guiding principles for all we do.
Collaboration is a priority—you’ll hear that said by many companies—but we’re actually doing it.
We are honest with ourselves, welcome different viewpoints, and empower each other to be authentic.

We value diversity and equality. It makes us stronger, more innovative, and better positioned for success. We are committed to inclusion across race, gender, nationality, religion, identity, experience, and any other unique attribute.

Continuous improvement is built into all facets of our business, from R&D, to team building, delivering sustainable solutions, and meeting the needs of our customers, shareholders, and global communities.
Priority number one. We are focused on our own personal safety as well as the safety of others.
We are resourceful. We are innovative and strive to apply the right technology and solution every time.
Enhancing the economic and social well-being of the communities where we live and operate is among our most enduring principles.

linguistic_shift: The page emphasizes collaboration and safety more explicitly compared to the prior year.
